theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), let q := WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk W.toAffine; let h := q W.ψ₂; let F : ℕ → W.toAffine.CoordinateRing := fun n => q (Polynomial.C (W.preΨ' n)) * (if Even n then h else 1); F 0 = 0 ∧ F 1 = 1 ∧ F 2 = h ∧ F 3 = q (Polynomial.C W.Ψ₃) ∧ F 4 = h * q (Polynomial.C W.preΨ₄) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → F (2 * r + 1) = F (r + 2) * F r ^ 3 - F (r - 1) * F (r + 1) ^ 3) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 3 ≤ r → h * F (2 * r) = F r * (F (r + 2) * F (r - 1) ^ 2 - F (r - 2) * F (r + 1) ^ 2))
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the pinned initial-value identities with the accepted odd- and even-recurrence declarations.
